verdict.rationale: Lago's API/OpenAPI schema and docs confirm programmatic subscription creation, plan changes, and credit/invoice management (lago-docs-19, lago-docs-4, lago-docs-1, lago-docs-16), and Lago ships a first-party Rust MCP server plus an 'Agent SDK' explicitly built for AI agents to operate billing (lago-docs-9, lago-docs-26, lago-docs-24, lago-docs-28, lago-probe-4). However, none of the evidence describes scoped/permissioned API keys or agent-specific permission boundaries — the MCP server is described as giving 'direct access to billing data' without granular scoping. Missing for 10: documentation of scoped/restricted API key permissions or role-based access controls for agent use, independent corroboration of MCP/agent SDK working end-to-end.
